_test_notes: GROUP I — Multi-field partial overlap. Triggers: cardio_high_amount (70k > 50k AND specialty=cardiology), long_stay_high_amount (70k > 50k AND days_stay=18 > 14), cardio_moderate (70k > 20k AND specialty=cardiology). All three rules share claim_amount > threshold (Level 4 overlap on amount), but differ on second conjunct. cardio_high_amount and cardio_moderate share both fields (Level 2 subsumption: > 50k implies > 20k, same specialty). cardio_high_amount and long_stay_high_amount share only amount (Level 4 partial overlap).
